tools.name: browse_home_posts
tools.description: Browse the main feed of posts and open a user-chosen post from the list (by title/snippet).

elements.purpose: open a post from the homepage by its title
open a post’s comments section via its comment-count link (e.g., ‘Leave a Comment’)

tools.name: paginate_post_list
tools.description: Navigate through paginated post listings (older/newer) to reach additional pages of results.

tools.name: open_post
tools.description: Open a specific post and read its full content and metadata (date/author/category) given a user-provided post selection (e.g., from search or listings).

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search posts by a user-provided keyword query and return/open matching results.

elements.purpose: open a post from the search results by title

tools.name: browse_by_category
tools.description: Browse posts within a user-specified category (e.g., technology) and open a selected post.

elements.purpose: open a post from the category list by title
‘Continue Reading’ to open the full post

tools.name: browse_by_month_archive
tools.description: Browse posts published in a user-specified month/year archive (e.g., December 2025) and open a selected post.

elements.purpose: monthly archive links in sidebar (choose month/year)
open a post from the archive list by title
‘Older posts’/‘Newer posts’ pagination within the archive

tools.name: open_recent_post
tools.description: Navigate via the ‘Recent Posts’ sidebar list and open a user-selected recent post.

elements.purpose: Recent Posts item links (open selected post)

tools.name: open_recent_comment_target
tools.description: Navigate via the ‘Recent Comments’ sidebar list to open the referenced post/comment thread for a user-selected recent comment.

elements.purpose: Recent Comments entry (opens the related post/comment context)

tools.name: post_comment
tools.description: Submit a new comment on a post using user-provided text and identity fields (name/email/optional website URL).

elements.purpose: optionally consent to saving name/email/website in browser cookies

tools.name: reply_to_comment
tools.description: Reply to an existing comment on a post by selecting a target comment and submitting a user-provided reply (uses the ‘Reply’ link to set the parent comment).

elements.purpose: ‘Reply’ link on the target comment (sets reply context)

tools.name: view_static_page
tools.description: Open and read a static informational page (e.g., Sample Page) from the site navigation.

tools.name: toggle_site_mode
tools.description: Toggle the site display mode (e.g., light/dark) using the site mode control.
